mapper.select: SELECT c.CHICKEN_ID as chickenId, c.BATCH_ID as batchId, c.AGE as age, c.RAW_WEIGHT as rawWeight, c.GROWTH_STAGE as growthStage, c.HEALTH_STATUS as healthStatus, c.FARM_NUM as farmNum, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN cih.VACCINE_TYPE = 'ND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as nd, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN cih.VACCINE_TYPE = 'HPAI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as hpai, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN cih.VACCINE_TYPE = 'IBD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as ibd, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN cih.VACCINE_TYPE = 'IB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as ib FROM CHICKEN c LEFT JOIN CHICKEN_INOCULATION_HISTORY cih ON c.CHICKEN_ID = cih.CHICKEN_ID WHERE c.BATCH_ID = #{batchId} GROUP BY c.CHICKEN_ID, c.BATCH_ID, c.AGE, c.RAW_WEIGHT, c.GROWTH_STAGE, c.HEALTH_STATUS, c.FARM_NUM ORDER BY c.CHICKEN_ID

SELECT BATCH_ID as batchId, ENTRY_DATE as entryDate, INITIAL_COUNT as initialCount, CURRENT_COUNT as currentCount, SHIPMENT_STATUS as shipmentStatus, FARM_NUM as farmNum FROM CHICKEN_BATCH WHERE FARM_NUM = #{farmNum} AND SHIPMENT_STATUS = FALSE ORDER BY ENTRY_DATE DESC

INSERT INTO CHICKEN_INOCULATION_HISTORY (CHICKEN_ID, VACCINE_TYPE, VACCINATION_DATE, VACCINATION_METHOD, VACCINATED_BY, NOTE) VALUES ( #{chickenId}, #{vaccineType}, #{vaccinationDate}, #{vaccinationMethod}, #{vaccinatedBy}, #{notes} )
mapper.select: SELECT HISTORY_ID as historyId, CHICKEN_ID as chickenId, VACCINE_TYPE as vaccineType, VACCINATION_DATE as vaccinationDate, VACCINATION_METHOD as vaccinationMethod, VACCINATED_BY as vaccinatedBy, NOTE as notes FROM CHICKEN_INOCULATION_HISTORY WHERE CHICKEN_ID = #{chickenId} ORDER BY VACCINATION_DATE DESC

SELECT cih.HISTORY_ID as historyId, cih.CHICKEN_ID as chickenId, cih.VACCINE_TYPE as vaccineType, cih.VACCINATION_DATE as vaccinationDate, cih.VACCINATION_METHOD as vaccinationMethod, cih.VACCINATED_BY as vaccinatedBy, cih.NOTE as notes FROM CHICKEN_INOCULATION_HISTORY cih INNER JOIN CHICKEN c ON cih.CHICKEN_ID = c.CHICKEN_ID WHERE c.BATCH_ID = #{batchId} ORDER BY cih.VACCINATION_DATE DESC, cih.CHICKEN_ID

SELECT cb.BATCH_ID as batchId, cb.CURRENT_COUNT as totalChickens, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cih.VACCINE_TYPE = 'ND' THEN cih.CHICKEN_ID END) as ndCompleted, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cih.VACCINE_TYPE = 'HPAI' THEN cih.CHICKEN_ID END) as hpaiCompleted, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cih.VACCINE_TYPE = 'IBD' THEN cih.CHICKEN_ID END) as ibdCompleted, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cih.VACCINE_TYPE = 'IB' THEN cih.CHICKEN_ID END) as ibCompleted FROM CHICKEN_BATCH cb LEFT JOIN CHICKEN c ON cb.BATCH_ID = c.BATCH_ID LEFT JOIN CHICKEN_INOCULATION_HISTORY cih ON c.CHICKEN_ID = cih.CHICKEN_ID WHERE cb.BATCH_ID = #{batchId} GROUP BY cb.BATCH_ID, cb.CURRENT_COUNT
